diagnostic_cautions: Frozen raw arm name source_supported denotes a structural source-definition evidence stratum, not globally-safe or reviewed substitutions.

The lexical-only source-entry projection omits noncontent grammatical roles and form/abbreviation analyses. either can be determiner/pronoun; dr also has doctor/drive/debit alias evidence. These require competing-analysis/source-use resolution and are not proved globally unambiguous.

Shortest-string synonym selection is deliberately naive and is not an ordinary-use preference. It selects regional or narrower alternatives such as ES brígido/lacroso/restorán and JA 医院. Full alternatives remain retained.
Source count completeness is not semantic equivalence, context safety, native reading accuracy or useful population coverage.
Known50/100/300 uses the same global TRAIN canonical family order across targets, not the first50/100/300 admitted entries in each pair. Actual selected family IDs are retained.
No new candidates promoted; no held-out input used to build or rank these entries.
